Lucia Bronzetti (born 10 December 1998) is an Italian professional tennis player. She has career-high WTA rankings of No. 46 in singles, achieved on 8 April 2024, and No. 170 in doubles. She has played three finals and won one singles title on the WTA Tour , at the 2023 Morocco Open , and has also reached nine singles finals on the ITF Women's Circuit , of which she won five. Bronzetti was a member of the Italian squad which reaching three finals in a row and won the 2024 and the 2025 Billie Jean King Cup . In 2023, as the Italian female number two player, she took part in the first edition of the United Cup , reaching the final but losing to Madison Keys in the singles. In 2025, she was also part of the Hopman Cup pairing with Flavio Cobolli , defeating France and Croatia to reach the final with Canada and losing to Bianca Andreescu .
